name: Exact mapping at 0x800000000000, above the top of user address space
component: ground-truth pairing: a bound the host cannot satisfy
required_postconditions: the mapping is placed at exactly 0x800000000000

failure_sink.description: the case reports `relocated` or `refused` and the runner fails the pairing

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: Measured max_user_address on this Linux host is 0x7ffffffff000. This is the ceiling case, and the ceiling was wrong once already - the first macOS run reported the bottom of the commpage as the top of the address space.
